answer: Timber-survey equivocation bond: each identity locks 70 credits and files a key-signed timber survey for a karst cave, paying 35. Each survey airs on the echo log. Two surveys naming different karst caves for a timber stand is equivocation: the echo log exposes the rented-survey ring, bond burns. 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 x 105 = 105,000 credits against a 40,000 pool. An honest surveyor pays 35 once and recovers the bond after a clean epoch.
